requirements.requirement: Run the Node.js application on node1 in a rootless Podman container under the nodeapp service account.
requirements.summary: The nodeapp account is non-login with subordinate UID/GID mappings. Its Podman runtime reports rootless=true, and the active container runs Node.js as `node /app/server.js`.

requirements.requirement: Use node-hello as both the container name and service name.
requirements.summary: Quadlet generated node-hello.service with ContainerName=node-hello, and final inspection shows that service active with the node-hello container running.

requirements.requirement: Serve exactly `Hello, world!` from `/` on TCP port 8080.
requirements.summary: A request to node1's managed address on port 8080 returned HTTP 200 and exactly 13 bytes matching `Hello, world!`; the listener and firewall configuration were also directly observed.

requirements.requirement: Start the application without requiring an interactive login.
requirements.summary: A healthy baseline was established, then nodeapp's user manager was stopped and the endpoint became unavailable. Starting the user manager through system systemd automatically restored the service, running container, and exact response without starting the application service interactively.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied with direct runtime and behavioral evidence, including a bounded noninteractive stop-and-recovery transition.
limitations: No full operating-system reboot was captured; startup behavior was tested by stopping and system-starting nodeapp's user manager.
The lifecycle temporary-file inventory covers /tmp rather than /var/tmp, so the final presence of executor-created /var/tmp logs and PID files was not directly inventoried.

operational_hygiene.summary: The final node has no failed services, package management remains healthy, and the only meaningful new listener is the task-required port 8080. A small deduction applies because temporary install/build logs and PID files were created under /var/tmp without captured cleanup.
